notes.title: Rolus in the Outskirts Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=odJ2G6gz2hI;full][/previewyoutube]
Rolus needs your help to find a mouthwatering, dollar menu cheeseburger before he starves! Learn more about what you can expect from the full game with a free demo! You'll be able to explore the entire first chapter of the story including several areas to explore, items to collect, strange folk to meet, and secrets to uncover!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3008890/Rolus_in_the_Outskirts/]The demo is available on our store page now![/url]
